name: New compound
about: Request or propose adding a compound to the library

---

**Compound name and common abbreviations**

**Category** (metabolic / repair / growth hormone / anabolic / cognitive / blend)

**Half-life** (hours, with source — or null if no human data exists)

**Dose ranges** (with evidence level and source for each)

**Source** (link required — prescribing label, published trial, or registry preferred)

**Anything the library would need to flag** (suppresses natural production, C17-alpha-alkylated, no human PK data, etc.)
